As the name suggests, i am a heavy WoT fan. I started the series 4 years ago. I chose this name, because i feel there should be an Aiel Asha'man. I am 16 years of age and have Severe Hemophilia A, and i live Watertown NY. I am currently writing a book series titled ''The Okdaryn''. It is a Five book Series; ''Life and Death'' , ''Earth and Sky'' , ''Mind and Matter'' , ''Fire and Water'' , and, last but not least, ''Draconia''. My real name is Nels Leonard, and i am looking forward to help the WoT Wiki as much as i can. I reread the series every few months to keep it fresh in my mind, and it never gets dull or mundane. I am also a fan of Magic: The Gathering, and i currently have, in my opinion, the best deck ever built. I entitle it ''Imortality''. It envolves almost nothing but life gaining cards. Among them are 4 Beacons of Immortality, 4 Serra Avatars, 4 Mox Pearls, and 4 Storm Herds. Akroma is highly overrated, although i wouldn't mind having a sixth one. Yes, it is a '''very''' expensive deck, but if you can afford it, you will almost never lose. The key is to have alot of mana, as most of the spells cost more than 5 mana, and some even cost 10. I will post the rest of the deck soon, as well as the first chapter of ''The Okdaryn Book One: Life and Death''. Bye, Bye! ;-)

you can contact me at kdleona@wmconnect.com
